# Agent Policy Engine

> Public component 09 in the MrCakes931 Agent Intelligence Ecosystem. Defines default-deny policy and request contracts plus a deterministic, experimental policy decision evaluator.

## Start here

- [Example request](examples/allow-request.json)

## Capability boundary
The evaluator validates schema-conformant inputs, applies explicit-deny-overrides and default-deny semantics, and returns a deterministic decision. It does not authenticate principals, distribute signed policies, or enforce decisions at protected resources. Treat it as an experimental decision-point reference, not a production authorization boundary.
